name: hotlap-nurburgring
_source: library/sim-rig/esports-flying-lap.mp4: Conspit 'Formula Challenge Pro' qualifying broadcast, Nürburgring GP. Lap offset, S1 split and best lap are read off the game's own HUD (lap timer = clip time + 2.953 s, checked at 1 s, 45 s and 56 s).

notes.text: Eyes up. Find the apex **before** you turn in.
Patience on throttle. **Exit speed** pays all the way down the straight.
